nodes.name: SPRINT_WORKFLOW_CHECKLIST.md
nodes.summary: Detailed sprint governance checklist enforcing the GWTF v3.0 and CCCDIR frameworks across architecture, implementation, testing, review, and merge phases. Codifies config-first architecture, Hydra CLI, schema-guard validation, LibCST guardrails, strict typing, regression tests, coverage, and a compliance scorecard for DutchBay contributions.

nodes.name: dependabot.yml
nodes.summary: GitHub Dependabot version-update configuration scheduling daily dependency checks for package manifests at the repository root. Drives automated dependency-bump pull requests for the DutchBay model.

nodes.name: pull_request_template.md
nodes.summary: Default GitHub pull-request template prompting contributors for a focused-change summary, test/doc updates, local pre-commit results, and the required green 'gate' CI check. Enforces the project's PR hygiene and review conventions.
